title: Ezekiel Chapter 38 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Ezekiel chapter 38 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Ezekiel Chapter 38 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Ezekiel Chapter 38.

questions.question: Who did the LORD command Ezekiel to set his face against and prophesy against?
questions.correctAnswer: Gog
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:2 commands the son of man to set his face against Gog and prophesy against him.

questions.question: What title is given to Gog in Ezekiel 38?
options: Chief prince of Meshech and Tubal
questions.correctAnswer: Chief prince of Meshech and Tubal
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:2 and 38:3 identify Gog as the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.

questions.question: According to Ezekiel 38:4, what will God put into Gog's jaws?
questions.correctAnswer: Hooks
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:4 states that God will put hooks into Gog's jaws.

questions.question: Which of the following nations is NOT listed as joining Gog's army in Ezekiel 38?
questions.correctAnswer: Egypt
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:5 names Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya, but does not mention Egypt.

questions.question: True or False: Ezekiel 38:6 mentions Gomer and the house of Togarmah as part of Gog's assembly.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:6 clearly includes Gomer and the house of Togarmah among those assembled with Gog.

questions.question: What command does God give Gog in Ezekiel 38:7?
options: Be thou prepared and prepare for thyself
Go up to the land of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Be thou prepared and prepare for thyself
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:7 instructs Gog to be prepared and prepare for himself and his company.

questions.question: In Ezekiel 38:8, when will Gog come into the land that is brought back from the sword?
options: After many days in the latter years
At the beginning of the year
questions.correctAnswer: After many days in the latter years
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:8 states that after many days, in the latter years, Gog will come into the restored land.

questions.question: True or False: Ezekiel 38:1 records that 'the word of the LORD came unto' Ezekiel.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:1 explicitly states that the word of the LORD came unto Ezekiel.

questions.question: Which is the correct order of events according to Ezekiel 38:2-7?
options: Set thy face against Gog, prophesy against him, be thou prepared
Be thou prepared, set thy face against Gog, prophesy against him
Prophesy against Gog, be thou prepared, set thy face against him
Be thou prepared, prophesy against him, set thy face against Gog
questions.correctAnswer: Set thy face against Gog, prophesy against him, be thou prepared
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:2 commands to set face against Gog and prophesy; verse 7 commands to be prepared.

questions.question: True or False: Ezekiel 38:3 states that the Lord GOD is for Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:3 says, 'Behold, I am against thee, O Gog,' indicating opposition, not support.

questions.question: What kind of armor is mentioned as being worn by Gog's horsemen in Ezekiel 38:4?
questions.correctAnswer: Bucklers and shields
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:4 describes Gog's army as clothed with all sorts of armor, including bucklers and shields.

questions.question: Which geographic direction is associated with the house of Togarmah in Ezekiel 38:6?
questions.correctAnswer: North quarters
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:6 identifies the house of Togarmah as being of the north quarters.

questions.question: According to Ezekiel 38:5, what protective gear do Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya wear?
questions.correctAnswer: Shield and helmet
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:5 states these nations come with shield and helmet.

questions.question: True or False: Ezekiel 38:8 says the mountains of Israel have always been fruitful and inhabited.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:8 says the mountains of Israel 'have been always waste' but are now inhabited.

questions.question: Who does Ezekiel 38:6 say will be with Gog besides Gomer and the house of Togarmah?
questions.correctAnswer: Many people
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:6 mentions 'and many people with thee' along with Gomer and Togarmah's bands.

medium.title: Ezekiel Chapter 38 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Ezekiel Chapter 38 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Ezekiel 38:9, how is Gog's coming described?
options: Like a storm and a cloud to cover the land
Like a gentle breeze over the mountains
Like a bright light shining in the darkness
questions.correctAnswer: Like a storm and a cloud to cover the land
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:9 explicitly states that Gog shall ascend and come like a storm and be like a cloud to cover the land, denoting a powerful and overwhelming arrival.

questions.question: What does Ezekiel 38:10 say will enter Gog's mind at the time of his invasion?
questions.correctAnswer: An evil thought
questions.explanation: The verse clearly mentions that Gog will think an evil thought, indicating malicious intent during the invasion.

questions.question: According to Ezekiel 38:11, what characteristics describe the people of the land Gog plans to attack?
options: Unwalled villages where people dwell safely without bars or gates
Fortified cities with strong walls and gates
Mountain fortresses well guarded by armies
questions.correctAnswer: Unwalled villages where people dwell safely without bars or gates
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:11 describes the land as unwalled villages with people dwelling safely, without bars or gates, making them vulnerable to attack.

questions.question: What purpose does Gog have for attacking the land, according to Ezekiel 38:12?
options: To take spoil and prey, turning his hand upon desolate places now inhabited
To establish friendship and trade agreements
To provide aid to the desolate regions
To build new cities and dwellings
questions.correctAnswer: To take spoil and prey, turning his hand upon desolate places now inhabited
questions.explanation: The verse explains Gog's intent to take spoil and prey, targeting desolate places that have become inhabited and prosperous.

questions.question: How do Sheba, Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish respond to Gog's gathering of his company, according to Ezekiel 38:13?
options: They question if Gog has come to take spoil and prey
They prepare to fight alongside Gog
questions.correctAnswer: They question if Gog has come to take spoil and prey
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:13 records these groups questioning Gog’s motives, suspecting he has gathered his company to take spoil and prey.

questions.question: Based on Ezekiel 38:14, what does God say about the safety of His people when Gog attacks?
options: They dwell safely and Gog does not recognize it
They are scattered among many nations
They are hidden in fortified cities
questions.correctAnswer: They dwell safely and Gog does not recognize it
questions.explanation: God points out that Israel dwells safely at that time, but Gog is unaware of this fact, according to Ezekiel 38:14.

questions.question: From Ezekiel 38:15, where does Gog come from and with what kind of force?
options: From the north parts with many people riding upon horses, a mighty army
From the south with a small group of foot soldiers
From the east with merchants and traders
From the west with peaceful envoys
questions.correctAnswer: From the north parts with many people riding upon horses, a mighty army
questions.explanation: The verse clearly says Gog comes from the north with many people, all riding horses, forming a great and mighty army.

questions.question: What is God's purpose in bringing Gog against the land of Israel according to Ezekiel 38:16?
options: So that the heathen may know God and He may be sanctified in Gog before their eyes
To punish Israel for their sins
To destroy Gog completely without any purpose
To test Israel’s faith in secret
questions.correctAnswer: So that the heathen may know God and He may be sanctified in Gog before their eyes
questions.explanation: God declares His intention to bring Gog against Israel so that the nations will recognize His holiness and be sanctified through this event.

questions.question: How does Ezekiel 38:17 connect Gog's coming to previous prophecies?
options: God affirms Gog is the one prophesied by the prophets of Israel long ago
It denies any connection to earlier prophecies
It describes Gog as a new, unknown enemy
It states Gog’s coming was unexpected and unpredicted
questions.correctAnswer: God affirms Gog is the one prophesied by the prophets of Israel long ago
questions.explanation: The verse confirms that Gog was spoken of by the ancient prophets as the enemy God would bring against Israel.

questions.question: What will happen to the land of Israel when Gog comes against it, according to Ezekiel 38:18 and 19?
options: There will be a great shaking in the land because of God's fury and jealousy
The land will remain peaceful and unaffected
The enemy will easily conquer the land
Israel will flee and abandon their homes
questions.correctAnswer: There will be a great shaking in the land because of God's fury and jealousy
questions.explanation: God's fury will cause a great shaking in Israel as described in these verses, showing divine intervention.

questions.question: According to Ezekiel 38:20, what is the effect of God's presence on all creatures and the land during Gog's invasion?
options: All creatures and men will shake, mountains will fall, and walls will be thrown down
Only the armies will tremble, but the land will remain intact
The animals will flee but the mountains will stand firm
There will be silence and stillness throughout the land
questions.correctAnswer: All creatures and men will shake, mountains will fall, and walls will be thrown down
questions.explanation: The verse vividly describes how everything on earth shakes and mountains and walls collapse at God's presence.

questions.question: What does Ezekiel 38:21 say about the conflict among Gog’s forces?
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: The verse states that every man's sword will be against his brother, indicating internal strife among Gog's forces.

questions.question: According to Ezekiel 38:22, which judgments will God bring upon Gog and his company?
options: Pestilence, blood, overflowing rain, great hailstones, fire, and brimstone
Peace and mercy to turn their hearts
questions.correctAnswer: Pestilence, blood, overflowing rain, great hailstones, fire, and brimstone
questions.explanation: The verse details a variety of judgments including pestilence, bloodshed, and natural disasters to defeat Gog’s forces.

questions.question: How does Ezekiel 38:23 show God's ultimate purpose in this judgment against Gog?
options: To magnify and sanctify Himself and be known by many nations
To punish Israel for their sins
To destroy the land completely without a witness
To hide His power from the nations
questions.correctAnswer: To magnify and sanctify Himself and be known by many nations
questions.explanation: God declares He will magnify and sanctify Himself so many nations will recognize Him, showing His sovereignty and holiness.

questions.question: Based on Ezekiel 38:11-12, what can believers learn about trusting God when facing unexpected threats?
options: Even when attacked unexpectedly, God’s people can dwell safely under His protection
Believers should always build physical walls for safety
Threats will always result in defeat without God's intervention
Avoid trusting God and rely solely on human strength
questions.correctAnswer: Even when attacked unexpectedly, God’s people can dwell safely under His protection
questions.explanation: These verses describe the people dwelling safely without walls, implying trust in God’s protection despite vulnerability.

hard.title: Ezekiel Chapter 38 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Ezekiel Chapter 38.

questions.question: According to Ezekiel 38:17, who is Gog identified as in relation to the prophets of Israel?
options: The one spoken of by the prophets many years ago
A new enemy unknown to the prophets
A distant nation unrelated to prophecy
questions.correctAnswer: The one spoken of by the prophets many years ago
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:17 states that Gog is the one about whom God had spoken by His servants the prophets many years before, indicating a fulfillment of ancient prophecy.

questions.question: What divine emotion is described as rising when Gog comes against Israel, according to Ezekiel 38:18?
questions.correctAnswer: Fury
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:18 declares that God's fury will come up in His face when Gog attacks Israel, indicating a strong divine judgment.

questions.question: What natural phenomenon is prophesied to occur in the land of Israel during Gog's invasion, as described in Ezekiel 38:19?
questions.correctAnswer: A great shaking
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:19 specifically mentions a great shaking in the land of Israel as part of God's judgment during this time.

questions.question: Which creatures are said to shake at God's presence during the events described in Ezekiel 38:20?
options: Fishes, fowls, beasts, creeping things, and all men
questions.correctAnswer: Fishes, fowls, beasts, creeping things, and all men
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:20 lists all these creatures as shaking at God's presence, emphasizing the universal fear and awe of God's manifestation.

questions.question: What will happen to the mountains, steep places, and walls during the invasion of Gog according to Ezekiel 38:20?
options: They shall be thrown down or fall to the ground
They shall be fortified and strengthened
They shall be covered with new growth
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be thrown down or fall to the ground
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:20 says the mountains will be thrown down, steep places will fall, and every wall will fall to the ground, symbolizing great upheaval.

questions.question: What is God's response to Gog's attack described in Ezekiel 38:21?
options: Calling for a sword against Gog, causing every man's sword to be against his brother
Sending a flood to drown Gog's army
questions.correctAnswer: Calling for a sword against Gog, causing every man's sword to be against his brother
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:21 indicates God will incite conflict within Gog's forces, leading to internal strife as part of divine judgment.

questions.question: Which means does God use to plead against Gog as stated in Ezekiel 38:22?
options: Pestilence, blood, hailstones, fire, and brimstone
questions.correctAnswer: Pestilence, blood, hailstones, fire, and brimstone
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:22 describes God using pestilence, blood, overflowing rain, hailstones, fire, and brimstone to judge Gog and his forces.

questions.question: What is the ultimate purpose of God's actions against Gog as explained in Ezekiel 38:23?
options: To magnify and sanctify Himself so many nations will know He is the LORD
To reward Gog for his bravery
To establish Gog as king over the nations
questions.correctAnswer: To magnify and sanctify Himself so many nations will know He is the LORD
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:23 clarifies God's judgment on Gog serves to magnify and sanctify Himself, making His identity known to many nations.

questions.question: Which of the following nations or peoples is NOT mentioned as part of Gog's allies in Ezekiel 38?
questions.correctAnswer: Babylon
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:5-6 lists Persia, Ethiopia, Libya, Gomer, and Togarmah among Gog's allies, but Babylon is not mentioned in this chapter.

questions.question: True or False: According to Ezekiel 38:15, Gog comes with a small band of warriors riding camels from the south.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:15 states Gog comes from the north with many people, all riding horses, forming a great and mighty army; camels and south are not mentioned.

questions.question: What does the Hebrew word 'Gog' likely signify in the context of Ezekiel 38, based on scholarly word study?
options: A symbol of evil or enemy
questions.correctAnswer: A chief or leader
questions.explanation: Scholars note that 'Gog' in Hebrew is often understood as a proper name referring to a chief prince or leader, fitting Ezekiel 38:2's description.

questions.question: Which other biblical passage is closely connected to the prophecy of Gog's invasion in Ezekiel 38?
questions.correctAnswer: Revelation 20:7-8
questions.explanation: Revelation 20:7-8 echoes the Gog and Magog motif as enemies gathered for a final battle against God's people, linking it to Ezekiel 38's prophecy.

questions.question: What literary device is predominant in Ezekiel 38:20 with the description of animals and men shaking at God's presence?
questions.correctAnswer: Parallelism
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:20 uses parallelism by listing diverse creatures and humans shaking in parallel structure to emphasize universal fear of God.

questions.question: True or False: Ezekiel 38:23 declares God's sanctification through judgment will be recognized only by Israel.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:23 states that many nations will see God's sanctification, not just Israel, showing the universal scope of His revelation.

questions.question: According to Ezekiel 38:19, what two emotions or states does God express that result in the great shaking in Israel?
questions.correctAnswer: Jealousy and wrath
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:19 notes God's jealousy and the fire of His wrath as reasons for the shaking, showing His protective zeal for Israel.

theological.title: Ezekiel Chapter 38 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Ezekiel Chapter 38 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What divine attribute is primarily demonstrated in God's declaration, 'Behold, I am against thee, O Gog'?
questions.correctAnswer: Sovereignty
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:3 shows God's sovereign authority in opposing Gog, illustrating His control over nations and history.

questions.question: Which nations are explicitly mentioned as allies with Gog in the invasion against Israel?
questions.correctAnswer: Persia, Ethiopia, Libya, Gomer, Togarmah
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:5-6 lists Persia, Ethiopia, Libya, Gomer, and the house of Togarmah among Gog’s allies in the coalition.

questions.question: What theological doctrine is revealed by God saying He will 'magnify myself, and sanctify myself' through His judgment on Gog?
questions.correctAnswer: Divine holiness and glory
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:23 reveals God's holiness and glory as He sanctifies Himself through judgment, emphasizing His distinctness and moral purity.

questions.question: How does Ezekiel 38 portray the state of Israel just before Gog's invasion?
options: In a state of spiritual apostasy
questions.correctAnswer: Dwelling safely without walls
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:11 describes Israel as dwelling safely in unwalled villages, indicating peace and security before the attack.

questions.question: What is the significance of God putting 'hooks into thy jaws' of Gog's army in this chapter?
options: God’s control and direction over Gog’s forces
questions.correctAnswer: God’s control and direction over Gog’s forces
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:4 indicates God's sovereign control, using the metaphor of hooks in jaws to show He directs Gog’s army as He wills.

questions.question: Sceptics claim prophecy about Gog invading Israel is too vague to be credible. What does Ezekiel 38:15-16 actually teach about this event?
options: It is a specific, divinely orchestrated future event with clear purpose
It is a general metaphor for all enemies of Israel
It is a past event already fulfilled
It is an allegory for spiritual warfare only
questions.correctAnswer: It is a specific, divinely orchestrated future event with clear purpose
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:15-16 clearly describes a future, detailed invasion led by Gog, orchestrated by God for His sanctification, affirming prophetic specificity.

questions.question: What combined theological insight do verses 18-20 provide about God's nature in the day of Gog's attack?
options: God’s wrath and power will visibly shake creation and manifest His jealousy
God will remain passive and allow destruction
God will forget His covenant promises
God will act in mercy without judgment
questions.correctAnswer: God’s wrath and power will visibly shake creation and manifest His jealousy
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:18-20 reveal God's fierce wrath and jealousy will cause a cosmic upheaval, demonstrating His holy justice and power.

questions.question: Which doctrinal truth is emphasized by the prediction that 'every man's sword shall be against his brother' in this prophecy?
options: The reality of divine judgment causing internal conflict
The unity of God's people in war
The promise of peace in the last days
questions.correctAnswer: The reality of divine judgment causing internal conflict
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:21 teaches that God's judgment will bring internal strife among invaders, highlighting the disruptive power of divine justice.

questions.question: What narrative arc connection does Ezekiel 38:8 make to Israel's history and future restoration?
options: Israel is regathered from many nations to dwell safely after exile
Israel remains scattered without hope of return
Israel conquers other nations before invasion
questions.correctAnswer: Israel is regathered from many nations to dwell safely after exile
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:8 refers to Israel being regathered from many peoples and dwelling safely, connecting to the restoration theme in biblical history.

questions.question: Which attribute of God is most clearly revealed in the promise to 'plead against him with pestilence and with blood'?
questions.correctAnswer: Justice
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:22 shows God's justice in actively punishing Gog and his armies through judgment and calamity.

questions.question: What is the theological significance of Gog's evil thought and intention to take spoil from Israel as described in Ezekiel 38:10-12?
options: It exemplifies human rebellion and greed against God's covenant people
It shows Gog's repentance and submission
It symbolizes spiritual darkness without real consequence
questions.correctAnswer: It exemplifies human rebellion and greed against God's covenant people
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:10-12 portrays Gog’s evil intent as rebellion against God's people, highlighting human sin and opposition to divine purposes.

questions.question: How does Ezekiel 38:17 clarify the prophetic nature of Gog's invasion in the broader biblical narrative?
options: It confirms that ancient prophets foretold this event, affirming divine revelation
It denies any prophetic origin of the Gog prophecy
It only refers to a local tribal conflict
It suggests Gog is a symbolic figure without historic reality
questions.correctAnswer: It confirms that ancient prophets foretold this event, affirming divine revelation
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:17 states God spoke of Gog through former prophets, reinforcing the continuity and reliability of Scripture’s prophetic witness.

questions.question: What synthesis of doctrine is evident when combining Ezekiel 38:13 and 38:14 regarding Israel's security and surrounding nations' perception?
options: Israel’s peace provokes suspicion and challenge from neighboring nations, highlighting divine protection
Israel is isolated with no concern from neighbors
Israel is preparing for conquest of neighbors
Israel’s security is due to military strength alone
questions.correctAnswer: Israel’s peace provokes suspicion and challenge from neighboring nations, highlighting divine protection
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:13-14 show that neighboring nations question Gog’s intent as Israel dwells safely, underscoring God’s protective providence.

questions.question: What combined teaching about God's purpose in judgment is derived from Ezekiel 38:16 and 38:23?
options: God brings judgment on Gog so that He will be sanctified and known among the nations
Judgment is arbitrary and lacks purpose
God’s judgment is hidden from the world
questions.correctAnswer: God brings judgment on Gog so that He will be sanctified and known among the nations
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:16 and 38:23 together show that God’s judgment manifests His holiness and makes Him known worldwide.

questions.question: What theological insight does Ezekiel 38:7 provide about preparedness in divine prophecy?
options: Gog is commanded to prepare, showing God’s control over human plans
Humans act independently without divine influence
Preparation is futile against God’s will
God's prophecy is conditional on human choice
questions.correctAnswer: Gog is commanded to prepare, showing God’s control over human plans
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 38:7 commands Gog to prepare, indicating that even evil plans unfold under God's sovereign direction.
